face.processing: Original attachment copied byte-for-byte; no new face generated
face.mapping: Uniform-scale frontal photo projection anchored to face-landmarks.json

hair.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: actual photo hair cutout texture for the user's 3D character. Edit target: the supplied close-up photograph. Extract ONLY the existing brown curly hair, preserving its exact curls, brown-gray color, silhouette, uneven fringe and fine flyaway strands from the input. Make every non-hair pixel fully transparent: remove face, skin, ears, neck, gray backdrop and the black rounded border. Where the face and ears were, leave a genuinely transparent hole, not dark hair fill. Keep the existing photograph's hair unchanged; no rerender, recolor, beautification, invented strands or different hairstyle. Preserve the same placement and full 1206-by-872 image framing if possible, including transparent margins. Output only the cutout, no labels, shadow, border or checkerboard.

footwear.method: Authored mesh surfaces, procedural materials, baked color and tangent normal textures

limits: Source photos do not reveal exact profile and back anatomy.
The normal outfit photo crops the front of the clogs.
Image registration measures texture alignment, not identity accuracy.
